scope: Measured source WAVs and schedule; decoded visual correctness requires frame review.

encoded_audio_waveform.method: Gain-invariant correlation of each decoded speech interval against canonical-resampled adopted WAV; no text prompt or decimal ASR normalization.

encoded_inter_digit_silence.scope: Only within-number word gaps; playback clips and number-transition holds are checked separately. Codec boundary guards exclude AAC pre-echo, not any intended speech.

encoded_between_number_pauses.scope: All 127 complete-value boundaries. Existing teaching narration and checksum-registered chimes are excluded from silence checks; their waveforms are checked independently.
